Data Analytics Senior Consultant II (Remote, US)
Allstate

Job Description
The Data Analytics Consultant II is responsible for leveraging data and analytics to answer moderately complex questions and influence business strategy through communication of findings to management.

Key Responsibilities
- Makes the business insights derived from data analytics accessible to those without technical skills.
- Provides technical expertise.
- Compiles, cleans, organizes, and analyzes moderately complex data to understand business results.
- Monitors and evaluates business initiatives against key performance indicators and communicates results and recommendations to management.
- Communicates and presents project information to team and provides presentations/updates to management.
- Establishes, modifies, documents, and communicates standards of practice around data retrieval, data manipulation, data quality, data reporting and data analytics.
- Influences strategy through data and analytics.

Essential Qualifications
- Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills
- Experience in different programming languages such as SQL
- Experience working in Microsoft Fabric
- Experience in different data visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI
- General insurance knowledge
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience working with Big Data
- 2 years of data and analytics experience

Skills
Ad Hoc Analysis, Advanced Analytics, Business Influence, Data Analysis, Data Analytics, Data Build Tool, Data Visualization, Structured Query Language (SQL), Structured Query Language (SQL) Development

Compensation
$75,100.00 - $126,325.00 annually
